stories.title: Online groomer jailed for 30 years at Chester Crown Court after police trace 70 victims
stories.summary: A man who posed online as a teenage boy called Reece to groom and blackmail girls has been jailed at Chester Crown Court after police traced 70 of his victims across the UK. stories.summary: Councillors’ recommendations for tackling flooding in places like Sandycroft, Pentre and Mancot have waited two years to be adopted, according to a motion going to Flintshire County Council next week. stories.title: Head of north Wales health board quits for English NHS trust
stories.summary: The boss of the health board that runs Wrexham Maelor Hospital and NHS services across Flintshire is leaving for a job in England. stories.title: Bird keepers across Wales must follow new bird flu rules from Monday
stories.summary: Anyone in Wales who keeps chickens, ducks, geese or other birds must follow new rules to stop the spread of bird flu from midday on Monday 16 November, however few birds they have. stories.title: Flintshire Cabinet accused of shelving school transport review until after election
stories.summary: The motion says a working group's recommendations missed an October deadline because Cabinet would not put them out to consultation.
